snapshot.title: Polish UI panels + mission timing progress
snapshot.description: Make all UI panels adopt a white, futuristic style (rounded corners, shadows, larger typography). Add mission distance progress bar based on 60s travel and store real launch time (unix). Potential parent: mzl2k8 (Launch mission) or 0x09aq (Create mission preview scene/view).

acceptanceCriteria.text: All UI panels use a cohesive white, rounded, shadowed style with larger typography
Mission list shows a distance progress bar reflecting real-time 0–60s travel
Launch time is recorded using real unix time and used for progress

changes.newValue:

4. Ensure launch time is recorded with real unix time at launch and progress updates in real time.
